cases.name: clean-clone-bootstrap
cases.precondition: Fresh checkout of the exact implementation commit with no generated local state.
cases.driver: Python 3 standard library plus pinned Go/Node/pnpm command probes
cases.oracle: Required bootstrap files resolve, repository remote is Techshrr/GoJet, root Go module and pnpm workspace are valid, and pinned tool commands are callable.

cases.name: no-external-or-prior-gojet-implementation-path
cases.precondition: Exact implementation checkout with Git metadata available.
cases.oracle: No gitlink/submodule, prior GoJet repository dependency, production Docker/Compose path, node_modules, or external implementation path is present.

cases.name: specification-identity-and-cross-reference-lint
cases.precondition: Three approved V10 specification files and traceability snapshots are present.
cases.oracle: Master/Design/IA IDs and cross-references resolve to V10, route snapshot is bound to the frozen IA blob, and no V5 identity token remains in governed project documents.

cases.name: directory-package-and-traceability-boundary-lint
cases.precondition: P00 repository boundary files, capability snapshot and route snapshot are present.
cases.oracle: Single root Go module, frontend workspace boundaries and P00 directory anchors are valid; capability snapshot has 38 REQUIRED rows and Route Registry snapshot has 131 registered rows without duplicate IDs.

cases.name: secret-scan
cases.precondition: All tracked P00 files are available as text or safely skipped as binary.
cases.driver: High-confidence credential/private-key pattern scan over tracked files
cases.oracle: No private-key material or high-confidence provider/access-token pattern is committed.

cases.name: license-inventory
cases.precondition: Go and frontend dependency manifests in the exact checkout are readable.
cases.oracle: Every declared third-party dependency is represented in the generated license inventory; P00 currently introduces no undeclared runtime dependency.
